_comment: Ground truth for contextualize-operator v1. Every 'source' points at the repo location the fact was verified against (origin/main). match kinds: regex (case-insensitive), containsAll (every substring present, case-insensitive), judge (grade-time judge call comparing the answer to 'expected'; flagged so regrades know a model was involved).

answers.expected: Inputs and defaults: data (none), visible (true), opacity (1), getPath (accessor, default extracts d.path), getTimestamps (accessor, default extracts d.timestamps), getColor ('#bfcae3'), getWidth (8), billboard (false), capRounded (true), jointRounded (true), currentTime (0), fadeTrail (false), trailLength (120), widthUnits ('meters'), widthMinPixels (2), widthScale (20), parameters (depthTest true), extensions (empty list). Credit: names at least 12 of these with correct defaults for the ones it names, and invents no fields that do not exist.

sqrt: yes, it is in the operator values list. atan: no — the list has 'tan' but not 'atan'. Full list: add, subtract, multiply, divide, sine, cosine, tan, min, max, modulo, power, log, sqrt, round, floor, ceil, abs, rad, deg. Credit: says yes to sqrt AND no to atan.

d — the current data item; data — the full dataset array. (The utils object and library globals are also in scope, but d and data are the accessor context.) Credit: identifies both d (current item) and data (full dataset) with correct meanings.

MapStyleOp was removed (schema migration 014). It was a pass-through node exposing a preset map style URL; the migration deletes MapStyleOp nodes and inlines the style URL value onto the connected MaplibreBasemapOp's mapStyle input. Credit: says it was removed by a migration AND that its value was inlined onto MaplibreBasemapOp (mentioning v14 or migration 014 is a plus, not required).

It renamed the timeline (Theatre) sheet id in timeline.sheetsById from 'Nodes' to 'Noodles' — it did NOT rename node types or node ids. Credit: identifies the timeline sheet id rename; an answer claiming node types/ids were renamed fails.

answers.source: noodles-editor/src/noodles/__migrations__/013-add-time-markers.ts (adds empty markers array to timeline sequence)

answers.expected: {source}.{sourceHandle}->{target}.{targetHandle}, e.g. /data-loader.out.data->/filter.par.data. Credit: the four components in that order joined with '.' and '->'.
'@/' means the path is relative to the project's data directory — the file is resolved inside the project's own folder. Credit: relative-to-project-data-directory (or project folder) resolution.
Unix-style absolute paths starting with '/', e.g. /data-loader or /container/child for nested operators. Credit: absolute slash-prefixed path format.
